# Composition follows tech: irregular hordes for tier 3/4 or no-arms nations;

# for regulars. Fleets (frigates) only for kingdom-tier+ regulars with a coast.
# Nations are grouped by the thematic region of their capital.
# Generated by tools/gen_military.py.
